geometry_and_frequency: wB97X-D4 / state-specific target basis / SMD(acetonitrile), Opt VeryTightOpt NumFreq TightSCF SlowConv for all newly generated or rescued legs

derivative_policy.frequency_hessian: numerical finite difference of analytical gradients
derivative_policy.terminology: NumFreq is not NumGrad; AnFreq changes the Hessian algorithm, not the frozen first-derivative requirement
derivative_policy.anfreq_audit: run as a paired diagnostic on identical converged geometries
derivative_policy.anfreq_adoption_gate: require exact wB97X-D4/basis/SMD compatibility and complete model-term, full-mode, thermochemistry QC; if adopted, amend the protocol globally rather than selecting per-leg winners

geometry_convergence_policy.imaginary_mode_workflow: restart from latest converged geometry with VeryTightOpt, then NumFreq and paired AnFreq on the identical final geometry before mode displacement or sampling-limited classification
geometry_convergence_policy.legacy_policy: retain prior TightOpt legs only when zero-imaginary-mode and all other QC passed; imaginary, suspicious-low-mode and resubmitted legs require VeryTightOpt
geometry_convergence_policy.evidence_required: convergence tier plus final energy, maximum/RMS gradient and maximum/RMS displacement criteria

label_eligibility_rule: A production redox or coordination label is eligible only when both legs use wB97X-D4/def2-TZVPD/SMD(acetonitrile) with the frozen thermochemistry policy. Existing M/def2-TZVP jobs are pilot diagnostics and must not be subtracted from def2-TZVPD charged legs.
selection_basis: ORCA 6.1.1 keyword support and neutral/charged smoke-run success
range-separated hybrid as the preregistered production family
diffuse functions retained for every state so paired legs use one basis rule
numerical stability, QC usability, and a single internally consistent label definition
selection_prohibition: The production method was not selected to maximize inversion count, preserve a preferred pair sign, or improve agreement with the target list.
audit_control: PBE0-D4/def2-TZVPD remains an independent sensitivity control and is not a second production method.
supersedes_candidate_ambiguity: method_settings.csv S1 and S2 were both labelled production_candidate; this freeze selects S2 for target labels and retains S1 only as historical pilot/diagnostic evidence.
